{"id":25498,"tenderTitle":"LISA-ITT-067 LCA Integration MGSE","tenderNumber":"26.OHBB.013","tenderDescription":"The gravitational wave observatory LISA (Laser Interferometer Space Antenna) has been selected as ESA’s third large class mission (L-3) within the Cosmic Vision programme. LISA’s mission objective is to observe gravitational waves from space in the frequency band of 0.1 mHz to 1 Hz, not accessible from ground-based observatories. 
The mission architecture consists of a constellation of three spacecraft placed at the vertexes of a near-equilateral triangle with side length of about 2.5 million km (LISA Constellation). An overview of the LISA mission and its objectives can be found on the Agency website here: https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Space_Science/LISA
OHB, prime contractor for the programme, has been contracted by the European Space Agency (ESA) for the realization of the LISA programme, building the industrial consortium.
The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the subcontractor for the LISA LCA Integration MGSE.
The LISA LCA Integration MGSEs shall provide several mechanical elements, such as trolleys and frames, to support the integration of the MOSA into the LCA. It shall enable flexible and safe height adjustment and rotation of the LCA to allow access for AIT operations, as well as provide a stable MGSE structure to support the LCA during test activities.
The MGSEs will be used under ISO 5 cleanliness conditions and in direct contact with high performance optical instruments.
